content:

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. As requested, I attached our company declaration and a preliminary W-9 for Redwood's vendor file. A couple of items I wanted to confirm so we can be fully set up for POs and payments:

- Legal entity name: Atlas Components, Inc.
- DBA we use for invoicing: Atlas Components
- Primary remit address: 1124 Harbor Drive, Suite 200, San Diego, CA 92101
- AP contact: Accounts Payable <accounts@atlas-components.com> (we also copy Murray there)

I attached the W-9 and our bank wire instructions. Please let me know if you need any additional legal docs or a signed vendor form from Redwood.

Thanks,

(858) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sabrina Tran <sabrina.tran@atlas-components.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Aug 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding packet + entity declaration

Hi Sabrina —

Appreciate the packet. Quick next steps from our side to get this into the vendor master and enable POs:

1) Confirm tax ID (EIN) as it appears on the W-9 — we need exact formatting.
2) Legal name and any subsidiary/parent relationships (if payments should flow to a different legal entity).
3) Preferred PO email address (we push POs to the AP inbox by default).
4) Banking: we can accept ACH in USD (domestic) or wire; include an ABA for ACH.

Laura, can you take point on the vendor record entry? Karthik, please flag any tax or payment controls that require escalation.

Sabrina — once we have the EIN and confirm the remit contact, we’ll create the vendor and issue a test PO (small, non-invoiceable internal PO) so AP can validate. Expected timeline: 2 business days after info is confirmed.

Best,
Ben
Sr. Sales Ops — Redwood Inference

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sabrina Tran <sabrina.tran@atlas-components.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Aug 2029 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding packet + entity declaration

Hi all —

Two quick clarifications from finance/controls side:

- We require the full EIN (no dashes) for our system; please confirm exactly as on your W-9.
- If you expect invoices from multiple legal entities or a parent company, let us know — our PO/ERP mapping is entity-specific.
- Wire vs ACH: for wires, we’ll need a signed bank letter OR a bank-originated PDF confirming account ownership for amounts > $50k.

If you prefer, Sabrina, we can accept a notarized bank letter; otherwise the wire instructions spreadsheet usually suffices for initial setup but will put holds on high-value payments until validated.

Karthik
Finance — Redwood Inference

Sabrina — I’m also sending a DocuSign now with our vendor onboarding acknowledgement (covers tax info, data handling and payment terms). Please sign so we can retain the signed copy in the vendor file: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/ABC123-envelope-id
